reached_sql:
WITH brand_month_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        dt.d_year,
        dt.d_moy,
        item.i_brand_id,
        item.i_brand,
        sum(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
    FROM date_dim AS dt
    JOIN store_sales
        ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dt.d_date_sk
    JOIN item
        ON item.i_item_sk = store_sales.ss_item_sk
       AND item.i_manufact_id = 816
    WHERE dt.d_moy = 11
    GROUP BY
        dt.d_year,
        dt.d_moy,
        item.i_brand_id,
        item.i_brand
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand_id AS brand_id,
    i_brand AS brand,
    sum(sum_agg) AS sum_agg
FROM brand_month_sales
GROUP BY
    d_year,
    i_brand_id,
    i_brand
ORDER BY
    d_year,
    sum_agg DESC,
    brand_id
LIMIT 100
